phrases.phrase: where the light is good at 6pm

routeTestNote: An interest amplifies what is locally abundant; it cannot summon a distant cluster. Asking for museums on a 20-minute Midtown walk changes nothing — Museum Mile is a kilometre off the corridor, and a per-edge discount cannot fund a detour that large, exactly as it could not reach the Hudson piers in Phase 2. Via-points are the mechanism for that. So these pairs deliberately pick corridors where the thing is genuinely nearby: they test that asking *works*, not that it works everywhere. Thresholds sit below observed gains with margin, and each exercises a different filter shape — feature-proximity, edge-tag, and both at once.

routeTests.name: Chelsea → East Village
routeTests.comment: feature-proximity filter, dense corridor (Union Sq, Washington Sq)

routeTests.name: Soho → Tribeca
routeTests.comment: edge-tag filter; Tribeca's sett streets are everywhere here

routeTests.name: Dumbo → Lower East Side
routeTests.comment: edge + feature filter. Baseline is already 2km of bridge because crossing the East River requires one, so the headroom here is small by construction — this checks the interest still adds on top of a saturated baseline.
